_comment: Provisional seed universe for the daily collector. The authoritative fund universe is built later from EDGAR N-CEN/N-PORT; this file exists so collection can start on day 1. Adding a symbol is cheap; a symbol never collected is a permanent hole.

treated_underlyings._comment: Underlyings with at least one dedicated option-income / covered-call / buffer programme.

control_underlyings._comment: Liquid names with no dedicated option-income programme as of the seed date; used as matched controls and as future-treated candidates.
